speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
title: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

points.text: Elder Neil L. Andersen spoke about “Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ”.

quotes.text: Seventeen-year-old Rosemary found a Joseph Smith pamphlet missionaries had left at her home in Zimbabwe. She read it and immediately received a spiritual witness that it was true; Joseph had seen God the Father and His Son, Jesus Christ. She was taught and baptized and became an example to her parents, who joined the Church 19 years later.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It has always taken spiritual courage, born of faith in Jesus Christ, to be His disciple. “I am alone,” Moroni wrote. “My father [and all my family have] been slain in battle, … and I have not friends nor whither to go.”
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Each week we prayerfully receive the sacrament and witness before God, and in the presence of others, that we “are willing to take upon [ourselves] the name of [Jesus Christ], and always remember him and keep his commandments.” Then, with courage, we are true to our covenants, and in turn, the Lord blesses us with increased faith.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It is our faith in Jesus Christ that gives us the courage to accept a calling from our priesthood leaders even when we feel inadequate or without sufficient time to accept the responsibility.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It is our faith in Jesus Christ that brings the spiritual courage to minister to others, live the Word of Wisdom, keep the law of chastity, honor the Sabbath day, be honest in our tithing, and trust our Father and His Son when unforeseen illness, financial troubles, or natural disaster upend our life.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: It is our faith in Christ that gives us the spiritual courage to speak openly with others about our Savior, make covenants in the house of the Lord, repent and receive forgiveness, follow living prophets, and be guided by the quiet impressions of the Holy Ghost.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Recently a noble woman of deep faith shared her testimony in church. Confidentially, I knew that she had been devastated by the betrayal of her husband. But with courage born of her faith, she powerfully declared that in happiness or unspeakable grief, she would trust in the rock of her salvation, her Savior, Jesus Christ.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: I promise you that as you strengthen your faith in Jesus Christ by believing and following Him and keeping His commandments, your answers will come, your spiritual power will increase, and your courage in following Christ will define your eternal soul.
quotes.speaker: Elder Neil L. Andersen
quotes.talk: Courage Born of Our Faith in Jesus Christ
quotes.session: Sunday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference
